conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.item1: Merchant will provide offers to Qatar Living users via the Living Deals program as per the attached offer form.
conditions.item2: Merchant authorizes Qatar Living to promote these offers across its platforms, apps, newsletters, and marketing channels.
conditions.item3: Merchant guarantees all marketing information is accurate, lawful, and not misleading.

businessCategories.title: Business Categories
businessCategories.loadError: Categories could not be loaded. Please refresh the page and try again.
businessCategories.empty: No categories are available yet. Please contact Qatar Living Deals support.

branches.title: Branches
branches.templateGuide: Download the template and read its Instructions sheet. Fill one branch per row in the Branches Data sheet, save it, then upload it here. Google Location must be a Google Maps link.
branches.empty: No branches added. Click "Add Branch" to add one.

deals.title: Deals
deals.templateGuide: Download the template and read its Instructions sheet. Fill one deal per row in the Deals Data sheet. Arabic fields are optional; use Yes/No for option fields and semicolons between multiple days or rules. Upload at least 4 images after importing.
deals.empty: No deals added. Click "Add Deal" to add one.
deals.dealTitlePlaceholder: E.g., Buy 1 Get 1 Free on All Pizzas
deals.durationTooltip: How long this deal stays active on the platform. E.g., "3 months", "6 weeks", or "1 year".
deals.redemptionTooltip: Choose "Unlimited" to let customers use this deal as many times as they want, or "Limited" to set a maximum per customer.
deals.twoTranches: Is this deal valid for two tranches?
deals.twoTranchesTooltip: A two-tranche deal splits the offer into two usage periods. For example, "Buy 1 Get 1" can be redeemed in two separate visits.
deals.specificDaysTooltip: Restrict this deal to certain days of the week. Useful for weekday-only or weekend-only promotions.
deals.multipleItems: This Deal is for Multiple Items
deals.multipleItemsTooltip: Enable this if the deal covers multiple products or menu items. Pricing won't be displayed on the deal card when enabled.
deals.multipleItemsInfo: If your deal is for multiple items, the price won't show on the deal card and details page.
deals.otherRulesPlaceholder: Enter claim rules or any additional terms...
deals.additionalTermsNote: Add rules such as: dine-in only; delivery/takeaway only; one voucher per person; one voucher per table, group, or bill; or multiple offers cannot be combined.
deals.pleaseSelectBranch: Please select at least one branch
deals.imagesError: At least 4 images are required for this deal
deals.dealTitleArPlaceholder: مثال: اشترِ 1 واحصل على 1 مجانًا على جميع أنواع البيتزا

fees.title: Fee Structure
fees.redemptionFeesText: Qatar Living will issue a monthly invoice for redeemed transactions; payments due within 15 days.
fees.unpaid: Unpaid balances may lead to suspension of offers until cleared.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.obligation1: Merchant ensures goods/service meet quality standards and comply with regulations.
terms.obligation2: Merchant will honor offers without extra fees or conditions.
terms.obligation3: Merchant will resolve user complaints promptly at no cost to Qatar Living or the users.
terms.obligation4: Merchant must provide an approved price list from the Ministry of Commerce and update Qatar Living on any changes.
terms.indemnityText: Merchant agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Qatar Living from any claims, damages, liabilities, or losses arising from the Merchant's breach of this Agreement, any misrepresentations, or any failure to deliver the goods or services as promised.
terms.entireAgreementText1: The agreement, together with the attached offer details and the Terms of Use available on the Qatar Living website (
terms.entireAgreementText2: ), constitutes the entire agreement between the parties. This Agreement and the attached documents represent the full and complete understanding between both parties and supersede all prior discussions, negotiations, or agreements.
terms.linkLabel: Please find the link to the Terms and Conditions below:
terms.acknowledge: By signing this Agreement, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by the Terms of Use published on the Qatar Living website.
terms.agreeCheckbox: I agree to the Terms and Conditions
terms.agreeDescription: By checking this box, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by the Terms of Use.
